name: vault-flow
description: An automation pipeline that converts social media bookmarks into download tasks, automatically fetches content, and organizes it into a structured local archive.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"

author: TanMusong
